meta.name: hyperframes-keyframes
meta.description: Use when a HyperFrames composition needs seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes, GSAP timelines, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, WAAPI, FLIP, paths, masks, SVG morph/draw, text trails, 3D depth, or `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics. Don't use for broad scene strategy, brand design, media sourcing, captions, or general video planning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 HyperFrames 合成添加安全的关键帧动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 HyperFrames 中制作精确的 2D/3D 关键帧动画
copy.tagline_en: Add seek-safe keyframe animations to HyperFrames compositions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need precise 2D/3D keyframe animations in HyperFrames

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会在 HyperFrames 项目里编写可跳转(seek-safe)的 2D/3D 关键帧动画,用 GSAP、CSS、Anime.js 等实现,并通过 hyperframes 命令验证每个时间点画面正确。
howto.when: 当 HyperFrames 合成需要 2D/3D 关键帧、GSAP 时间线等 seek-safe 动画,或要求运行 hyperframes keyframes 诊断时触发;不用于整体场景策划、品牌设计、视频规划等。

say.text: 给这个场景里的 Logo 添加一个沿路径移动的动画,最后停在原位。
say.note: Claude 会按规则写路径关键帧并用命令验证。

say.text: 为这段文字做逐字显现的效果,保持可跳转。
say.note: 会生成有序偏移的 keyframes 并检查可读帧。

say.text: 运行 hyperframes keyframes 检查当前合成有哪些关键帧问题。
say.note: Claude 会执行诊断并修复失败项。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude writes seek-safe 2D/3D keyframe animations in HyperFrames compositions using GSAP, CSS, Anime.js, etc., and verifies the picture at each time point with hyperframes commands.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a HyperFrames composition needs seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes, GSAP timelines, or hyperframes keyframes diagnostics; not for broad scene strategy, brand design, or video planning.

say_en.text: Add a path-following animation for the Logo that ends back at the start.
say_en.note: Claude writes path keyframes and verifies with commands.

say_en.text: Make these words fade in one by one, keeping it seek-safe.
say_en.note: Creates staggered visible keyframes and snapshots readable frames.

say_en.text: Run hyperframes keyframes to check issues in this composition.
say_en.note: Claude runs diagnostics and fixes failing items.
